كيف يتعامل موقع وليد زون مع بيانات الحسا: How Waleed Zone handles account, session, favorites and visit statistics data.
آخر تحديث: 4 أكتوبر 2026. نوضح هنا البيا: Last updated: October 4, 2026. This policy explains the data Waleed Zone processes when you browse or create an account.
عند التسجيل نحفظ اسم العرض والبريد الإلك: When you register, we store your display name, email address, a securely hashed password and account creation date. Your email is not shown to visitors. We store the items you add to favorites.
نضع ملف تعريف ارتباط ضروريًا للدخول، صال: We use an essential sign-in cookie valid for up to seven days. We store a hash of the session token on the server and temporarily use request data, such as the network address, to limit abusive sign-in attempts.
نسجل عدد الزيارات باستخدام معرّف مشتق من: We count visits using an identifier derived from request data and a private key that changes daily, without storing the raw network address in the visit record. This hashed daily identifier does not guarantee complete anonymity. We also store aggregate daily counters for detail views, download page views, preparation, redemption and Telegram redirects. The counter table does not store raw network addresses, full user agents, download destinations or file message numbers, and these counters do not use a dedicated cookie. Events may repeat for the same visitor, and some counts may be lost during outages or heavy traffic. Hosting infrastructure may keep separate operational logs.
قد تفتح روابط التحميل وتيليجرام مواقع خا: Download and Telegram links may open external sites with their own policies.
إعداد عرض الإعلانات مفعّل، لكن كل موضع ي: Advertising is enabled in the serving configuration, but each placement requires page review and privacy consent.
إعلانات Google مغلقة من إعدادات العرض حا: Google advertising is currently disabled in the serving configuration.
عند إتاحتها قد تستخدم Google وشركاؤها مل: When available, Google and its partners may use cookies, identifiers and measurement technologies to serve and personalize ads. Personalized advertising depends on interest signals and consent; non-personalized advertising does not use a similar personalization profile but may use serving and measurement technologies. The current implementation does not serve a replacement ad when consent is refused. We do not load advertising code before a valid consent decision from a consent management platform (CMP) configured for this purpose. Refusing ads does not prevent browsing or downloads.
